overview: Sales Dashboard is a local Node.js web app for scheduled CSV sales-call transcript exports. It profiles import quality, deduplicates calls, runs deterministic local transcript evaluation, optionally submits local model jobs through the AI Execution Layer, persists derived local history, and renders a manager-facing dashboard without using unsupported phone/date, sales, or revenue assumptions.
objective: Surface contact quality, meaningful conversations, follow-up signals, imported-outcome mismatches, source/list quality, manager review queues, import history, and generated reports while preserving privacy and data-confidence boundaries.

steps: Start with node src/main.js --csv "C:\Users\User\Downloads\July 1 Data.csv" or set SALES_DASHBOARD_CSV_PATH.
Deduplicate by call_id and ignore privacy-reduced or invalid fields for analytics.
Evaluate each transcript locally with deterministic rules in src/transcriptEvaluator.js.
Link follow-up signals through stable source IDs only.
Build metrics, alerts, sanitized evaluation rows, and explorer rows in src/analysis.js.
Persist derived import history, evaluation artifacts, alert/review state, and reports through src/storage.js.
Submit optional local model transcript jobs through src/aiExecutionLayer.js and C:\Users\User\Desktop\ai-execution-layer.

architecture: src/main.js: local HTTP server, health route, summary API, and reload route
src/analysis.js: data profiling, metrics, alert construction, and sanitized rows
src/storage.js: ignored local JSON store, import artifact writer, generated report saver, and manager review persistence
src/aiExecutionLayer.js: optional local AI Execution Layer client for transcript jobs
src/dashboardRenderer.js: HTML rendering and escaping layer

unsupported_metrics: order value generated by a call
guardrails.phone_matching: Use stable source IDs only. Do not use partial phone values for matching or display.
